result.summary: The page appears mostly polished, but one layout issue stands out: the bottom restaurant card is clipped by the bottom edge of the screen, making it look visually broken/incomplete. There is also minor text truncation on one of the horizontal restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom edge of the screen and appears to extend behind the bottom navigation bar area, making the card look incomplete and potentially obscuring content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content container so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal card is truncated with an ellipsis, so the full name is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Either widen the card, allow text to wrap to a second line, or use a shorter display name so the full restaurant name is readable.
